description: Fix inconsistent realized R:R / per-trade P&L in smc_fvg_strategy.pine. Root cause is opposite-direction reversal-netting under a single net position: with pyramiding=100 an entry in the opposite direction of the currently-open position does NOT stack independently; strategy.entry first CLOSES all open opposite-direction trades at the reversal (opposing-signal) fill price and then flips, so those trades realize arbitrary P&L instead of their own from_entry SL/TP, breaking the configured RRR. Gate placeStrategyOrder so an entry is only submitted when it does not conflict with an already-open opposite-direction market position, so every filled trade exits via its own SL/TP and realized R:R matches configured RRR (aside from inherent bar-model gap slippage on a tiny SL, which is a settings/instrument reality to be documented, not a code fix). Edit ONLY smc_fvg_strategy.pine at repo root. This is the single feature for this task; no environment-setup feature exists because there is no local Pine toolchain to set up.
steps: Read smc_fvg_strategy.pine, focusing on the strategy() header (line ~2), placeStrategyOrder (lines ~410-443), and the two call sites in displayStructure() (placeStrategyOrder(true, f.top, f.bottom) after a bullish break and placeStrategyOrder(false, f.bottom, f.top) after a bearish break, ~lines 610 and 650).

Add a direction-conflict guard inside placeStrategyOrder BEFORE strategy.entry is called. Determine the current net position direction from strategy.position_size (>0 long, <0 short, ==0 flat) and skip placing the order when the requested direction is opposite to a currently-open position. Concretely: if isBull and strategy.position_size < 0 -> do not place (return without entry); if (not isBull) and strategy.position_size > 0 -> do not place. Same-direction (adds to the pyramid) and flat (opens fresh) are allowed. Implement without early return if that is cleaner in Pine: wrap the entry+exit+tradeOrders.push block in the guard condition so nothing is submitted on conflict. Do NOT push to tradeOrders when the order is skipped (the cap array must only track real orders, and the projection/cap logic must stay consistent).

Preserve the existing exit placement exactly: strategy.exit(id + '_x', from_entry = id, loss = slTicks, profit = tpTicks) with slTicks = slPointsInput / syminfo.mintick and tpTicks = tpDist / syminfo.mintick, tpDist = tpModeInput == TP_RRR ? rrrInput * slPointsInput : tpPointsInput. Do NOT change the SL/TP unit or the tick conversion.

Update the placeStrategyOrder doc comment to explain the new guard and WHY: Pine holds one net position; pyramiding stacks only same-direction entries; an opposite-direction entry would reverse/net and close open trades at the opposing fill (not their SL/TP), so opposite-direction signals are skipped while a position is open to keep every filled trade exiting at its own from_entry SL/TP and preserve the configured R:R. Note that inherent bar-model gap slippage on a tiny SL relative to the instrument's bar size can still make a single realized fill exceed the level (a settings/instrument reality, not a code bug).

Respect Pine v5 constraints: placeStrategyOrder is a void function that must still end with a trailing `true`; do NOT reassign any GLOBAL scalar inside the function; no break/continue; keep any loop guarded. strategy.position_size is a built-in series readable inside the function (no reassignment needed).

Do NOT alter unrelated behavior: structure detection, FVG highlighting, the concurrency cap semantics (other than not counting skipped orders), the trade projection (maintainTradeProjections / drawProjection / tradeOrder UDT), the dashboard stats, the VWAP filter, or the Limit/Market entry modes.

Run git diff to confirm the change is confined to placeStrategyOrder (and its doc comment) in smc_fvg_strategy.pine and no other file is touched. Commit on branch fix/rrr-consistency with a conventional fix: message describing the root cause and the guard.
acceptance_criteria: placeStrategyOrder no longer submits a strategy.entry whose direction is opposite to an already-open market position (checked via strategy.position_size), so open trades can only be closed by their own from_entry SL/TP, never by reversal-netting from an opposing signal.

The exit call still uses from_entry=id with loss=slPoints/mintick and profit=tpDist/mintick unchanged, so the tpDist:slDist = RRR:1 ratio is preserved and realized R:R matches configured RRR for the normal (non-gap) case.
placeStrategyOrder still ends with a trailing `true`; no global scalar is reassigned inside it; no break/continue introduced.
tradeOrders is only pushed for orders that were actually submitted (skipped conflicting orders do not consume a cap slot and do not create phantom projections).
git diff shows changes ONLY in smc_fvg_strategy.pine, confined to placeStrategyOrder and its doc comment; structure/FVG/projection/dashboard/VWAP/entry-mode logic unchanged.
A doc comment explains the reversal-netting root cause, the guard, and the residual inherent gap slippage on a tiny SL.
verification: Static Pine v5 semantics review: confirm strategy.entry opposite-direction reversal behavior under a single net position, confirm strategy.position_size sign convention, confirm from_entry-scoped strategy.exit places loss/profit ticks from that entry's own fill.
Read the final placeStrategyOrder and verify the guard wraps entry+exit+push, the function ends in trailing `true`, and no global scalar is reassigned inside it.
git diff origin/main -- smc_fvg_strategy.pine and confirm the change is minimal and confined as described; git status shows only smc_fvg_strategy.pine (plus .agents task-state) changed.

findings: ITERATION 2 (addresses the 2026-09-14-085513 review, verdict NEEDS_CHANGES). The prior fix (commit 76f8e0f) ANDed a single `bool directionOk = isBull ? strategy.position_size >= 0 : strategy.position_size <= 0` into the placement `if`. That closed the ACROSS-BAR already-filled case but the review found two residual reversal-netting paths because strategy.position_size only reflects ALREADY-FILLED orders: (1) SAME-BAR opposite entries - displayStructure(true) (internal) and displayStructure() (swing) both run every bar and both read the same pre-bar position_size, so a flat book could submit a long from the internal pass and a short from the swing pass in the same bar, both passing the guard, one reverse-netting the other on fill; (2) PENDING LIMIT entries - a submitted-but-unfilled limit does not move position_size, so a later opposite signal still passed. FIX: expanded the guard in placeStrategyOrder to gate on the SUBMITTED/OPEN direction in addition to net position. It now computes `posConflict = isBull ? strategy.position_size < 0 : strategy.position_size > 0` (across-bar filled case) AND scans the tradeOrders array (bounded for-loop, guarded by `if tradeOrders.size() > 0`) for any tracked order whose isLong != isBull, setting `trackedConflict`. `directionOk = not posConflict and not trackedConflict`. tradeOrders holds every submitted order (pending limit, or open) with its isLong field and is only pruned by maintainTradeProjections once the trade CLOSES, so scanning it detects both a same-bar earlier-submitted opposite entry (it was pushed to tradeOrders by that call) and a resting pending-limit opposite order - closing both residual paths. Same-direction signals (isLong == isBull) never set trackedConflict and pass posConflict, so pyramiding/stacking still works; a flat book with no opposing tracked order still opens fresh in either direction. Skipped orders remain fully skipped (no strategy.entry, no strategy.exit, no tradeOrders.push, no cap slot, no projection). Exit tick math (loss=slPoints/mintick, profit=tpDist/mintick, tpDist=RRR*slPoints for TP_RRR) UNCHANGED - SL/TP units untouched. Doc comment expanded to describe the fuller guard covering net position AND pending/open tracked orders (same-bar and pending-limit cases) plus the still-documented residual inherent bar-model gap slippage on a tiny SL (a settings/instrument reality, not a code bug). Pine v5 constraints respected: function still ends with trailing `true`; only LOCAL bools/loop-var are assigned (no GLOBAL SCALAR reassignment inside the function); tradeOrders is only read via .get and mutated via .push (array object mutation, allowed); loop is bounded and guarded; no break/continue. git diff origin/main confined to placeStrategyOrder + its doc comment in smc_fvg_strategy.pine (single hunk) plus .agents task-state files. Review issue #3 (re-backtest) is unresolvable here: no local Pine toolchain exists, so no compile/backtest was possible; verification was by static Pine v5 semantics review. The user MUST re-backtest the XAUUSD case (SL=4, RRR=10, Market) in TradingView to confirm realized winners/losers now track the 10:1 distances for surviving trades.
